banner: moa7amed-queue by moa7amed: Queue. Route. Execute. Verify. A persistent task queue for Claude Code.
lifecycle: Diagram of how a queued task is executed: queue, route, claim, optional read-only analysis, execute, verify, commit; deep material plans wait for approval; a crash is recovered by the next runner.
workflows: Diagram comparing the QUICK, STANDARD and DEEP workflows.
multi-agent: Diagram of stage A multi-agent analysis: concurrent read-only agents on a snapshot, integration by the queue, and the coordinator as the only writer.
queue-and-run: Terminal: three tasks are added and routed, task 3 is made to wait for task 2, the status table lists them, and the runner executes them one after another.
routing: Terminal: task 3 is set to Sonnet by hand; the route report shows the automatic choice for tasks 1 and 2, and for task 3 the recommended Opus, the manual Sonnet and the DEEP workflow.
workflow: Terminal: the workflow report shows each task's profile, capabilities, planning and required verification.
agents: Terminal: the agent evaluation chooses two read-only agents for task 3; agents show lists their process ids, overlapping start and end times, snapshot isolation, input revision and reported cost.
approval: Terminal: task 3's plan waits for approval, the owner approves it, and the next run implements it.
verification: Terminal: task 3's record with its result, model and agents; the git log with one commit per task; the project's tests passing; the usage report.
recovery: Terminal: a runner is killed while a task runs; status reports the stale lock; the next run recovers the interrupted task and finishes it; the history shows both attempts.
bid-and-replica: Terminal: a BidStudio project is created and a synthetic tender document recorded; a Replica project is created from the team's own HTML prototype; both report their status.
auto-queue: Real output from an interactive Claude Code session: three queue: prompts are saved as tasks 1 to 3 (the first starts a runner, the others wait behind task 1, and the restored text of task 2 is not saved again); then moa7amed-queue auto, status and history show the four tasks done one after another, the runner stopping when idle and starting again for a later task.
